name: Aurora Dune Symphony
description: Golden desert dunes that resonate with gentle music, illuminated by an ethereal aurora painting the sky in shifting colors.
prompt: Expansive desert dunes covered in golden sand, each ripple vibrating with soft musical notes, under a sky ablaze with dancing aurora borealis in greens, pinks, and purples; cinematic, surreal, luminous, widescreen, no text.
caption: Feel the music of the sands as the dunes sing beneath the dancing aurora.
